title: Work with every project's sessions remotely from the Claude Code app, through the Genlock Assistant as one hub
user_said: TJ wants to work with every project's sessions remotely from the Claude Code app. Per-session Remote Control keeps dropping because sessions are short-lived, so the Genlock Assistant session acts as the single orchestration thread (the hub) and relays to projects.

text: Remote button: --remote-control on the Assistant, persisted, survives restarts and swaps (remote-button)
Relay back: project sessions' full replies and questions reach the Assistant (relay-back)
Start a fresh session on a project from the Assistant: genlock open (open-from-hub)
Show the Assistant's chosen name everywhere (assistant-name)
Hold off on per-session Remote Control (each new session inheriting it) unless relaying through the Assistant proves too limiting
